sha: SET-AT-LAUNCH: branch stale-stop (1eface8, from 80b3bbd) rebased onto the fleet sha at launch
notes: DROPPED ITEMS -> A STALE PATHFINDER STOP (2026-09-29). Both engines measured 13,275 pickup drops retired unreached in 6 h (27.5/bot-h, 73/80 bots) and 12.8% of gathers barren (block dug, drop left). Root cause (Claude analysis, verified in mineflayer-pathfinder 2.4.5 source): stop() only sets a flag, consumed by the next setGoal's reset or at a path node; withTimeout did setGoal(null) THEN stop(), so the flag outlived the walk and the NEXT goto died instantly (PathStopped) -- >= 1,261 skips carry that signature. The stuck reflex stopped a bot before unstick(), and the dig watcher around a direct dig did the same. THE FIX: haltPath = setGoal(null) alone (resetPath already halts completely; never sets the flag; consumes one left elsewhere), at every site; withTimeout's finally consumes the dig watcher's flag; goto's leg listeners removed; the pickup skip row carries err=/item=/d=/ms=. Implementation reviewed by Claude and Codex independently; all findings fixed (96a0b55, 1eface8): the dig-watcher gap, the err= order, and Codex's fullStop-mid-air side effect of the first draft. 8 real-pathfinder tests (the old order is the positive control), mutants killed, 204/204, sandbox smoke clean. WHY THE GATE IS CORRECTNESS: deterministic; the fast re-skip share is reported only because a dry run on UNCHANGED code read it as fixed (hive-c 0.041 vs control 0.135).

POSITIVE CONTROL: the fast re-skip signature is visible in control (932 in the dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.
